sections.label: 🔧 Refactor
items: Barcode highlighting's on/off toggle moved out of the h1 toolbar's 🛠 View ▾ menu into the "Barcode" column header itself, as a ▶/▼ toggle mirroring the Length column's ⏱ toggle. `Ctrl+B` (and prefix-mode `b`) still toggle it directly; `#mb-barcode-highlight-btn` no longer exists.
